high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "barelyopinionated." The post is titled "District collector helps provide electricity to 900 schools!" and features a green header with white text. The content of the post highlights an achievement by Dr. Jitendra Kumar Soni, who took over as District Collector in July 2020. It states that over 900 schools in the Nagaur district of Rajasthan have been fully electrified since his tenure began. Specifically, the post mentions that a meticulous survey identified exactly 979 schools running without electricity.
